function: Excluded (above_phy): MADDPG learns only UAV/ARIS trajectories and UAV active/passive mode switching. ARIS phase shifts (SDR) and GU association are optimized, not learned (p. 6; p. 9).
notes: p. 6: the MADDPG learning action "includes the UAVs' flying direction and speed", while "the ARIS's passive beamforming and GUs' association strategies" come from "the optimization method". p. 7: "Problem (22) is a standard SDR problem". p. 9: the learned action adds "the mode-switching strategy", whether each UAV is an active AP or a passive ARIS reflector. I read that as a node-role decision above PHY. If the reviewer reads it as RIS configuration or aerial resource control, the work passes to function/area checks. no_learning was not used because learning is core to the method. The PDF is arXiv:2412.20484v1 and has the same title and authors as the DOI.
